purpose: Day-0 free verification for the Markets/Launch contracts — every result a view call or source read, zero transactions, zero spend

a1ArbitraryDepositToken.verdict: YES — no token allowlist, registry, or token screening exists anywhere in the deployed pool
depositPathChecks: privacy.cairo:1025 assert(token == note_token, TOKEN_MISMATCH) — equality with our own CreateOpenNote, not an allowlist
a1ArbitraryDepositToken.screening: address-based only: privacy.cairo:994-997 blocked_open_note_depositors.read(contract_address) — the exposure is OUR contract being blocklisted, never the token
a1ArbitraryDepositToken.prerequisite: an OpenSubchannel per open-note token, emitted in the same transaction (privacy.cairo:734 SUBCHANNEL_NOT_FOUND)
a1ArbitraryDepositToken.provenLive: compile_actions accepted open notes on a PHANTOM token (0x12d02fb028941fb98aba3bbcce111f07202c0f59267e17cae531241da723 — no contract deployed there), 1-3 notes, mixed STRK+phantom subchannels — the graduation case exactly

pragma.stalenessFinding: two reads ~11 min apart returned the SAME timestamp (234s old, then 665s old); all pairs share one timestamp. A 120s freshness guard would have voided during the measurement window — the void-and-refund rule is load-bearing, and the resolve window must expect waits

actionShapes.bet: [SetViewingKey, OpenChannel, OpenSubchannel, Deposit, CreateEncNote(change), Withdraw, InvokeExternal] — compiles, 15 server actions
actionShapes.claimNOpenNotes: compiles with 1, 3, and 5 CreateOpenNotes (17/21/25 server actions); note-creation phase order free; indices must be sequential per channel-and-token (INDEX_NOT_SEQUENTIAL on gaps, NON_ZERO_VALUE on repeats); each token its own subchannel
actionShapes.useNoteCaveat: the literal UseNote leg is untestable from a throwaway (NOTE_NOT_FOUND reads real storage); Deposit stand-in exercises identical balance rules — same limitation the existing ACTION_LIST_EVIDENCE records

trap: compile_actions CANNOT catch an unmatched open note (compiler no-ops EmitOpenNoteCreated at privacy.cairo:772; real path counts at :895 and asserts zero at :903 UNDEPOSITED_OPEN_NOTES) — three open notes with no invoke compiled OK and would revert on-chain AFTER the 6 STRK fee. The client must assert open-note count == expected deposits; the pool's free view cannot
gift: CreateOpenNote takes no token_balances in dispatch (privacy.cairo:287-290) — open notes are balance-neutral, funded by the invoked contract; the N-strike batch claim genuinely fits one transaction
encoderNote: CreateEncNoteInput is six fields ending at salt (actions.cairo:85-101); encodeClientActions in message-book.ts covers only SetViewingKey/OpenChannel/InvokeExternal — the other variants are hand-rolled (see scripts/ops/rehearse.mjs)
scripts: scripts/ops/{rehearse,errs,a1}.mjs — copy to repo root to run (they resolve `starknet` from node_modules)
